entities.name: Rowland Hill, 1st Viscount Hill
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: General Rowland Hill, 1st Viscount Hill, was a British Army officer and politician who served in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. Hill became Commander-in-Chief of the Forces in 1828. Well-liked by the soldiers under his command, he was nicknamed "Daddy Hill".
